name: Beeper
author: Beeper Inc.
summary: All your chats in one app. Yes, really.
description: A single app to chat on iMessage, WhatsApp, and 13 other chat networks. You can search, snooze, or archive messages. And with a unified inbox, you’ll never miss a message again.
